rules.reply:
A Venatori gladiator vaults the low wall of the lower courtyard, blade already moving. Cassandra shouts a warning as he comes for you.
[combat: enemies="Venatori Gladiator"]

default: The torches of Skyhold gutter as the wind shifts. What do you do?
The courtyard is quiet again. Cassandra wipes her blade and nods to you. What next?
